met_analysis:
The well marked low pressure area over coastal West Bengal and adjoining areas of Bangladesh & northwest Bay of Bengal, moved northwestwards, concentrated into a Depression and lies centered at 0830 hrs IST of today, the 13th August, 2026, over coastal West Bengal near latitude 22.3°N and longitude 88.6°E, close to northwest of Canning (West Bengal), about 40 km southeast of Kolkata (West Bengal), 130 km east of Medinipur (West Bengal), 190 km east-northeast of Baripada (Odisha) and 260 km east-southeast of Jamshedpur (Jharkhand). It is very likely to move nearly northwestwards across Gangetic West Bengal and Jharkhand during next 24 hours.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood extending upto 5.8 km above mean sea level and tilting southwards with height persists.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Firozpur, Muzaffar Nagar, Barabanki, Dehri, centre of Depression over coastal West Bengal and adjoining areas of Bangladesh & Northwest ay of Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The Shear Zone roughly along Lat. 22°N across central & adjoining north Peninsular India between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle and upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 68°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Haryana & neighbourhood persists and now seen at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
